title: Perch
gist: An owl in the Mac menu bar that shows how much of your Claude week is gone, for every account you use, and when each one resets.
summary: See each Claude account's week used and its reset time from the menu bar, instead of opening the usage page.

hero_image.alt: The Perch popover under its menu bar owl, staged with two example accounts: the second at 65% of its week used with 4d 20h to reset, the main one at 100% and limit reached

headline_numbers.label: CPU, owl still, counting what Perch spawns

baseline_note: Measured for 2.0 on an M4 Pro, macOS 26, about 1,170 processes, one two-minute run each with the popover closed.

site.blurb: I run two Claude accounts and kept opening the usage page to see which one still had room this week. Perch puts that number next to the clock, and a click on the owl shows each account's plan, the week used and when it resets. It uses 0.18% of one core with the owl still. The usage figures come from an undocumented endpoint that can change.
site.line: Your Claude week, per account, in the menu bar
site.key: CPU, owl still, counting what Perch spawns
site.description: An owl in the Mac menu bar that shows how much of your Claude week is gone, for every account you use, and when each one resets.
site.result: One section per account with its plan, the week's percent used, the reset countdown and the Fable week, plus the picked account's percent beside the owl. With the popover closed it uses 0.18% of one core and 23 MB with the owl still, and 2.1% with the owl idling.
site.catch: The usage figures come from an undocumented Anthropic endpoint that can change, several accounts need a poller Perch does not include, and the app is not notarized, so a downloaded copy needs the quarantine flag cleared.
site.method: Every number comes from Scripts/bench.py, which builds its own Release copy under a separate bundle id and runs it with the popover closed. Measured for 2.0 on an M4 Pro, macOS 26, about 1,170 processes, one two-minute run each.
site.foot: Usage comes from an undocumented endpoint; not notarized yet.
